content.short: Predipie is a TON football prediction game where players join match picks through Telegram and compete for token rewards.
content.description: Predipie is a football prediction platform that uses Telegram and TON based wallet flows to let players join match focused contests. The project presents itself as a lower risk alternative to traditional sports betting, with gameplay built around predictions, token participation, community activity, and reward campaigns. Rather than functioning like a sportsbook, Predipie is framed as a social game where users engage with football outcomes through a structured Web3 experience that emphasizes participation, community, and repeat play.
content.meta: Predipie brings football prediction gameplay to TON through Telegram and token rewards. Explore Predipie on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
